text: This report requests Council's authority for the City to assume the municipal road and services installed under the terms of the Subdivision Agreement between Manse Developments Inc. and City of Toronto relating to registered Plan of Subdivision 66M-2537.

City Council on May 11 and 12, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council assume the services installed within Blocks 57 and 58 and Heron Park Place, and that the City formally assume the roads within the Plan of Subdivision 66M-2537. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to release the performance guarantee held with respect to the municipal services in accordance with the Subdivision Agreement. 3. City Council direct that an assumption By-law be prepared to assume the public highway and municipal services within the Plan of Subdivision 66M-2537. 4. City Council authorize and direct the City Solicitor to register the assumption By-law in the Land Registry Office, at the expense of the Owner. 5.
